note: Pharmacy prints the customer's business facts directly in the Instructions (DECISIONS 88, option B; pharmacy since DECISIONS 94). These are the only variables a pharmacy Instructions set may use. Any other {{var.*}} is an error; so is an unresolved slot such as <business name>. This list replaces docs/shared/variables.json for pharmacy. 'status: unconfirmed' means the platform has not confirmed the variable exists.

variables.name: now_local
variables.description: Today's date and time for the call, with the dates of the coming days. Every date the agent says is read off this list.

variables.name: customer_name
variables.description: Outbound refill reminder calls: the name of the customer being called. Used only to ask for the person; never said to anyone who is not confirmed as that customer, and never left on a voicemail. Whether the platform passes this is an open question.

variables.name: refill_details
variables.description: Outbound refill reminder calls: the medicine due for refill. Said only after the person is confirmed as the customer and has given the order number. Whether the platform passes this is an open question.
